Rugged handheld / 6.5″ / Windows 11 IoT

Tuga WH6

Windows in your pocket.

£799 No VAT to add. Free UK delivery in 7 to 10 working days

The WH6 puts full Windows 11 in your pocket. An Intel Celeron N5100, 8GB of RAM and 128GB of storage (plus a microSD slot for more) run the Windows software your industry never moved off, reach network drives, and manage field data without compromise. It is rated IP65 and MIL-STD-810H, survives 1.5 metre drops, and works from -20°C to 60°C. The 4000mAh battery is removable, so a spare keeps you going through a long shift, and 4G LTE, GPS + GLONASS and NFC are on board. USB-A and USB-C ports connect straight to instruments and peripherals. A 2D barcode scanner is available as an option for warehouse and logistics work, and a charging dock is sold separately for desk use.

Buying for a business? Get a quote and pay by bank transfer. Trial units welcome.
